wiki.title: Mike Lee (Hawaii politician)
wiki.extract: Michael Gee Kwong Lee (born 1981 or 1982) is an American politician serving as a member of the Hawaii House of Representatives for the 50th district since 2024, defeating incumbent Natalia Hussey-Burdick in the primary. He previously ran for the seat in 2022 but lost to Hussey-Burdick in the primary by 240 votes.
